spec_provided_observability.name: WS edge
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Channel boundary marker; receiver can verify expected periodicity (e.g. 32 SCK periods per channel for 16-bit stereo).

spec_provided_observability.name: SCK frequency
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Bit clock; can be measured externally to verify sample rate × 2 (channels) × bits-per-sample.

notes: I2S 2.0 does NOT specify any protocol-level error detection, CRC, parity, or framing error reporting. There is no handshake or acknowledgment. Concrete I2S controller IPs may add FIFO overrun / underrun status registers, but these are per-implementation, not protocol-defined.
